issue.title: error routing on alpha 34
issue.body: im getting router_1.RouteConfig is not a function on 34 but when i switch back to 33 its okay. Is there a change in name?

body:
Hello again @pkozlowski-opensource, I was wondering if you could elaborate a bit on your workaround. I was trying to do what you told me but I'm not so familiar with how SystemJS works so I'm pretty sure I'm doing something wrong. Would you please post the line I need to add to config.js to load the global plugin? Thanks in advance.

Btw, I tried using alpha 33 of angular2.dev.js and alpha 34 of router.dev.js. This combination works.

> I'm not so familiar with how SystemJS works so I'm pretty sure I'm doing something wrong. Would you please post the line I need to add to config.js to load the global plugin? 

@hitmanmcc the problem is that we are using a relatively old version of the SystemJS builder so config is a bit involved and probably not the easiest to explain to something new to module loading / systemjs. What you can do instead is to remove the offending line from https://code.angularjs.org/2.0.0-alpha.34/router.dev.js

Just replace `return System.get("@@global-helpers").retrieveGlobal(__module.id, false);` with `return {};`, see: http://plnkr.co/edit/8yAktull0fFQIW82hZOU?p=preview

I'm looking at the root cause of this issue as we speak

Thanks for the quick reply @pkozlowski-opensource but alas, that did not work as well.
I have two sample applications where I tried loading a local version of the router.dev.js script with the modification you instructed me to perform. Both of them produced the same error, in which it is stated that there is no provider for the Router.
![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/3464842/9172281/7e82ee3e-3f6a-11e5-931a-bcd194c7ffc3.png)

![image](https://cloud.githubusercontent.com/assets/3464842/9172294/8dc41db4-3f6a-11e5-8ad3-1215d74ea2c8.png)

If there's anything I can do to assist you in tracking down the issue, feel free to ask.

@hitmanmcc I've identified the root cause (see https://github.com/systemjs/builder/issues/271) and will have a PR for angular repo shortly. So the pb with the build is well identified and we don't need help tracing it, thnx.

Regarding the error you are getting - I'm not sure I can help more without having access to your setup. I've got the impression that the error you are getting is not related to the loading problem we are discussing here. 

The best I can do is to share with you a plunker with a version of a Router build locally. As you can see router loads without pbs in this plunk: http://plnkr.co/edit/TGWFcnQC5f3jrPmdnwXZ?p=preview

Try to demonstrate the issue in this plunk, maybe someone will be able to help you then.

issue.title: chore(build): don't use global module format in router bundle
issue.body:
Empty ES6 files are detected as "global" module format by
default which means that we end up with 2 module formats in
a bundle (es6 and global). This makes module loading more
complex and make break with certain SystemJS builder / loader
combinations.

Fixes #3528
